name: 5-in-1 Electric Hair Dryer Brush Kit | Blow Dryer, Straightener, Curler & Volumizer Styling Tool
description:
The 5-in-1 Electric Hair Dryer Brush Kit is your all-in-one styling solution—designed to dry, straighten, curl, and volumize hair while protecting it from heat damage. Featuring 1000W power, adjustable heat settings, and interchangeable attachments, it delivers salon-quality results at home or on the go. Lightweight and travel-friendly, it’s perfect for daily styling or special occasions.
Key Features
 1000W power with 3 temperature settings for all hair types
 5 interchangeable heads: dryer, curler, straightener, volumizer & massage brush
 Negative ion technology for smooth, frizz-free, shiny hair
 Ceramic coating to reduce damage and protect strands
 Lightweight, portable, and easy to carry anywhere
 Ideal gift for women and girls on any occasion
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, ceramic coating, heating elements, nylon bristles, electrical components
How to Use
 Attach the desired styling head
 Select heat/speed setting according to hair type
 Use on towel-dried or dry hair for best results
 Style, curl, straighten, or volumize as desired
Package Includes
 1 × Main Handle with Power Cord
 1 × Blow Dryer Head
 1 × Curling Wand Attachment
 1 × Straightener Brush
 1 × Volumizer Comb
 1 × Round Massage Brush
